'''Neilyn''' is a performer in [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]].

==Appearance==
[[Olver]], who is taken with Neilyn, says that her eyes are the prettiest he has ever seen. He makes the same statement about [[Merici]].{{ref/book|9|15}}

==Activities==
Neilyn is one of several women who have taken an interest in Olver. When he leaves the show with [[Matrim Cauthon]], Olver spends time with Neilyn, [[Adria]], [[Gillin]], [[Jameine]] and Merici.{{ref/book|9|15}}
